description:
Sabanci University is a university that wants to raise competent and self-confident individuals in every field and at an international level and contribute to the production and development of knowledge in the fields of natural sciences and engineering, as well as human and social sciences and management sciences through innovative and transdisciplinary research.

Students take an active role in education and research activities at Sabanci University at all levels, from undergraduate programs to postdoctoral researchers. In addition to the research activities that students take part in within the scope of their undergraduate course obligations; They are encouraged to take part in research into real problems through programs such as Industry Focused Projects and PURE. In this way, students have the opportunity to get to know the outside world closely before work or academic life during research. In addition, many students have the chance to continue their careers in industry and research institutions where they take part in projects together during their education life.

One of the most important building blocks of research is postgraduate programs and postgraduate students who play a major role in improving the research capacity of the university. The Research and Graduate Policy Directorate manages the Graduate Policy process by contributing to the determination of the number of graduate students and the number of scholarships. Sabancı University provides various educational and research supports to undergraduate and graduate students.

Sabancı University approaches its students, students' families, employees, administrators, and the whole society with a sense of sensitivity and responsibility, with the goal of having a participatory, self-managed, financially autonomous, and flexible structure.

Promising a campus life to students, Sabanci University promises students education, academic success, and entertainment in many subjects. Sabanci University offers academic education, participation in various clubs, and socialization opportunities in its large campus located in Tuzla, Istanbul.
